# ⚔️ Armory

> Armory is the open-source, ever-evolving registry of every agent-harness component on earth — MCPs, skills, hooks, sub-agents, identity files, memory patterns, rules, CLIs, eval frameworks, observabil

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Component is a registry: a knowledge graph of agent-harness components. Adding one is adding a single markdown file — an component — under b
- [STRUCTURE.md](STRUCTURE.md): The whole repo in one map. Every root folder is listed here with a one-line purpose, grouped into five zones. Counts grow nightly (AutoLab) 
- [HARNESS.md](HARNESS.md): Two different things live in this repo. Don't confuse them.
